judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong message and type names (`list_sessions`/`session_list` instead of `list_conversations`/`conversation_list`, and `ListSessionsMessage`/`SessionListMessage`/`SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`/`ConversationListMessage`/`ConversationSummary`). It completely omitted the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in configuration flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it violated an explicit requirement and acceptance criterion by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store lacks `listFor` instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error, and by allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation instead of enforcing 1–200. It also failed to update `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`, while leaving behind an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file.
